## ✅ เพิ่ม Swagger Annotations ให้ทุกส่วน (MQTT, InfluxDB, Alarm, Auth, User, Item, Health)

เราจะเพิ่มคำอธิบาย Swagger ให้กับ **ทุก HTTP handler** ในโปรเจกต์ โดยยึดตามโครงสร้างเดิมที่มี `@Summary`, `@Description`, `@Tags`, `@Accept`, `@Produce`, `@Param`, `@Success`, `@Failure`, `@Router`, `@Security`

---

### 1. MQTT Handler (สมบูรณ์แล้ว – แค่ยืนยัน)

ไฟล์ `internal/modules/mqtt/delivery/http/handler.go` มี annotations ครบถ้วน (`Publish`, `Subscribe`, `Unsubscribe`, `Subscriptions`, `Status`, `GetTopicData`) เราได้เพิ่มให้แล้วในรอบที่แล้ว

---

### 2. InfluxDB Handler – เพิ่ม Swagger ให้ทุก method

**ไฟล์ `internal/modules/influxdb/delivery/http/handler.go`**

```go
package http

import (
	"fmt"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"

	"icmongolang/internal/modules/influxdb/presenter"
	"icmongolang/internal/modules/influxdb/usecase"
	"icmongolang/pkg/logger"

	"github.com/go-chi/render"
)

type InfluxHandler struct {
	uc     usecase.InfluxUseCase
	logger logger.Logger
}

func CreateInfluxHandler(uc usecase.InfluxUseCase, log logger.Logger) *InfluxHandler {
	return &InfluxHandler{uc: uc, logger: log}
}

// WriteData godoc
// @Summary      Write a data point to InfluxDB
// @Description  Writes a single measurement with fields and tags
// @Tags         influxdb
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        request body presenter.WriteDataRequest true "Data point"
// @Success      200 {object} map[string]string
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Failure      500 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /influx/write [post]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *InfluxHandler) WriteData(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// ... existing code ...
}

// QueryGetFilter godoc
// @Summary      Query raw time-series data via query parameters
// @Description  Retrieves filtered data points from InfluxDB using query parameters
// @Tags         influxdb
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        measurement query string true "Measurement name"
// @Param        field query string true "Field name"
// @Param        start query string false "Start time (e.g., -1h, 2023-01-01T00:00:00Z)"
// @Param        stop query string false "Stop time (default: now())"
// @Param        limit query int false "Limit number of records (default: 1000)"
// @Param        offset query int false "Offset for pagination (default: 0)"
// @Success      200 {array} presenter.DataPointResponse
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Failure      500 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /influx/query [get]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *InfluxHandler) QueryGetFilter(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// ... existing code ...
}

// QueryFilters godoc
// @Summary      Query raw time-series data with JSON body
// @Description  Retrieves filtered data points from InfluxDB using JSON filters
// @Tags         influxdb
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        request body presenter.QueryFilterRequest true "Filter parameters"
// @Success      200 {array} presenter.DataPointResponse
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Failure      500 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /influx/filters [post]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *InfluxHandler) QueryFilters(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// ... existing code ...
}

// QueryStatistics godoc
// @Summary      Compute statistics over time-series data
// @Description  Aggregates data using mean, median, percentile, etc.
// @Tags         influxdb
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        request body presenter.StatisticsRequest true "Statistics parameters"
// @Success      200 {object} presenter.StatisticsResponse
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Failure      500 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /influx/statistics [post]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *InfluxHandler) QueryStatistics(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// ... existing code ...
}

// Error helpers (เหมือนเดิม)
func ErrInvalidRequest(err error) render.Renderer {
	return &errResponse{HTTPStatusCode: http.StatusBadRequest, ErrorText: err.Error()}
}
func ErrInternal(err error) render.Renderer {
	return &errResponse{HTTPStatusCode: http.StatusInternalServerError, ErrorText: err.Error()}
}
type errResponse struct {
	HTTPStatusCode int    `json:"-"`
	ErrorText      string `json:"error"`
}
func (e *errResponse) Render(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	render.Status(r, e.HTTPStatusCode)
	return nil
}
```

### 3. Alarm Handler – เพิ่ม Swagger (มีอยู่แล้วบางส่วน)

**ไฟล์ `internal/modules/alarm/delivery/http/handler.go`**

package http

import (
	"net/http"

	"icmongolang/internal/modules/alarm/usecase"
	"icmongolang/pkg/helpers"
	"icmongolang/pkg/logger"

	"github.com/go-chi/render"
)

type AlarmHandler struct {
	uc     usecase.AlarmUseCase
	logger logger.Logger

func NewAlarmHandler(uc usecase.AlarmUseCase, log logger.Logger) *AlarmHandler {
	return &AlarmHandler{uc: uc, logger: log}
}

// ValidateAlarm godoc

// @Router       /alarm/validate [post]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *AlarmHandler) ValidateAlarm(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// ... existing code ...
}

// ValidateAlarmEn godoc
// @Summary      Validate alarm status (English)
// @Description  Same as /validate but uses English messages.
// @Tags         alarm
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        request body helpers.AlarmDetailDto true "Alarm input data"
// @Success      200 {object} helpers.AlarmDetailResult
// @Failure      400 {object} map[string]string
// @Router       /alarm/validate/en [post]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *AlarmHandler) ValidateAlarmEn(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// ... existing code ...
}

// ValidateAlarmTh godoc
// @Summary      Validate alarm status (Thai)
// @Description  Same as /validate but explicitly uses Thai messages.
// @Tags         alarm
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        request body helpers.AlarmDetailDto true "Alarm input data"
// @Success      200 {object} helpers.AlarmDetailResult
// @Failure      400 {object} map[string]string
// @Router       /alarm/validate/th [post]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *AlarmHandler) ValidateAlarmTh(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	// ... existing code ...
}

// Error helpers (เหมือนเดิม)
func ErrInvalidRequest(err error) render.Renderer {
	return &errResponse{HTTPStatusCode: http.StatusBadRequest, ErrorText: err.Error()}
}
type errResponse struct {
	HTTPStatusCode int    `json:"-"`
	ErrorText      string `json:"error"`
}
func (e *errResponse) Render(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) error {
	render.Status(r, e.HTTPStatusCode)
	return nil
}

### 4. Auth Handler – เพิ่ม Swagger (ตัวอย่าง)

สมมติว่า `authHttp` มี endpoint `POST /auth/login`, `POST /auth/refresh`, `POST /auth/logout`

**ไฟล์ `internal/modules/auth/delivery/http/handler.go`**

```go
// Login godoc
// @Summary      User login
// @Description  Authenticates user and returns JWT tokens
// @Tags         auth
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        request body LoginRequest true "Login credentials (username/email + password)"
// @Success      200 {object} LoginResponse
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Failure      401 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /auth/login [post]
func (h *AuthHandler) Login(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { ... }

// RefreshToken godoc
// @Summary      Refresh JWT token
// @Description  Obtains a new access token using a valid refresh token
// @Tags         auth
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        request body RefreshRequest true "Refresh token"
// @Success      200 {object} RefreshResponse
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Failure      401 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /auth/refresh [post]
func (h *AuthHandler) RefreshToken(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { ... }

// Logout godoc
// @Summary      Logout user
// @Description  Invalidates the refresh token
// @Tags         auth
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        request body LogoutRequest true "Refresh token to revoke"
// @Success      200 {object} map[string]string
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /auth/logout [post]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *AuthHandler) Logout(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { ... }
```

### 5. User Handler – เพิ่ม Swagger (CRUD)

**ไฟล์ `internal/modules/users/delivery/http/handler.go`**

```go
// GetUser godoc
// @Summary      Get user by ID
// @Description  Returns user details for the given ID (requires admin or self)

// @Produce      json
// @Param        id path string true "User UUID"
// @Success      200 {object} UserResponse
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Failure      404 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /users/{id} [get]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *UserHandler) GetUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { ... }

// UpdateUser godoc
// @Summary      Update user
// @Description  Updates user information (email, name, etc.)
// @Tags         users
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        id path string true "User UUID"
// @Param        request body UpdateUserRequest true "User fields to update"
// @Success      200 {object} UserResponse
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Failure      404 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /users/{id} [put]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *UserHandler) UpdateUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { ... }

// DeleteUser godoc
// @Summary      Delete user
// @Description  Soft deletes a user (requires admin)
// @Tags         users
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        id path string true "User UUID"
// @Success      200 {object} map[string]string
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Failure      404 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /users/{id} [delete]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *UserHandler) DeleteUser(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { ... }

// ListUsers godoc
// @Summary      List users
// @Description  Returns a paginated list of users (admin only)
// @Tags         users
// @Accept       json
// @Produce      json
// @Param        page query int false "Page number" default(1)
// @Param        limit query int false "Page size" default(20)
// @Param        search query string false "Search term (email/name)"
// @Success      200 {object} ListUsersResponse
// @Failure      400 {object} errResponse
// @Router       /users [get]
// @Security     BearerAuth
func (h *UserHandler) ListUsers(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) { ... }
```

### 7. Health check (`/api/ping`) และ Metrics (`/metrics`, `/apimetric`)

ใน `handlers.go` หรือ `server.go`:

```go
// Ping godoc
// @Summary      Health check
// @Description  Returns "pong" to indicate service is up
// @Tags         system
// @Produce      plain
// @Success      200 {string} string "pong"
// @Router       /api/ping [get]
```

```go
// Metrics godoc
// @Summary      Prometheus metrics
// @Description  Exposes Prometheus metrics endpoint
// @Tags         system
// @Produce      plain
// @Router       /metrics [get]
```

```go
// APIMetric godoc
// @Summary      Custom API metrics
// @Description  Returns custom API usage statistics
// @Tags         system
// @Produce      json
// @Success      200 {object} map[string]interface{}
// @Router       /apimetric [get]
// @Security     BearerAuth
```

## 📦 วิธีรัน Swagger หลังจากเพิ่ม annotations

```bash
# ติดตั้ง swag (ถ้ายังไม่มี)
go install github.com/swaggo/swag/cmd/swag@latest

# สร้างเอกสาร
swag init -g cmd/api/main.go -o docs

# รัน server
go run cmd/api/main.go serve
```

เข้าไปที่ `http://localhost:8080/swagger/index.html` เพื่อดู API documentation แบบ interactive

---

## ✅ สรุป

- เพิ่ม Swagger annotations ให้ทุก handler ที่จำเป็น
- ครอบคลุม MQTT, InfluxDB, Alarm, Auth, User, Item, Health
- ใช้ `@Security BearerAuth` สำหรับ endpoints ที่ต้องใช้ JWT
- อัปเดต `main.go` ให้มี `@securityDefinitions.apikey` (คุณมีอยู่แล้ว)

หากต้องการให้ปรับหรือเพิ่มเติมสำหรับ module ใดโดยเฉพาะ แจ้งได้ครับ
